concerns.text: Plan Phase 1 explicitly includes an 'a-priori power note for detecting ΔAUC = 0.05 with three predictors under Bonferroni correction', but no task in tasks.md produces this power-analysis artifact. T004 covers the noise sweep and null control only. An implementer following the tasks cannot satisfy this plan element.

data-model.md declares contracts/policy_head.schema.yaml and contracts/adapter_output.schema.yaml as validation contracts for the PolicyHead manifest and AdapterModelOutput, and T007 depends on both entities, but no task creates or validates against these two schema files — only structural_record.schema.yaml is covered (T001). Add a task (or extend T007) to author and apply these contracts.

Plan's project structure lists src/utils/data_io.py and src/utils/logger.py plus tests/contract/test_structural_record_schema.py; tasks have no task covering these modules or the contract-test file. The schema-conformance check is equivalently covered inside T001's test_extractor assertions, but the utils modules have no covering task — either add them to an existing task's scope or note they are implementation detail.
